Character Sheet
I run a Play By E-Mail Game based on the Star Trek universe, and these are the fields I generally use when I ask new players to submit a character. These are useful if you're a story-writer as well, as it helps you to develop a new character with boundaries, but still allow enough freedom for that character to expand as time goes on. If you'd like to see my game, or are interested in playing, go here to take a look around.
